client_id.description: The client identifier Laylo issued to your integration. Treat it as opaque.

client_secret.description: The signing secret Laylo issued to your integration. Keep it on a trusted server.

grant_type.description: Not required, and not read. It is listed only so a standard OAuth client-credentials helper can post its usual body unchanged.

startDate.description: First UTC day of the window (inclusive), as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the first day of endDate's month.

endDate.description: Last UTC day of the window (inclusive), as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. The window can span at most 366 days.

interval.description: How to bucket the series. Defaults to day.

relatedProductId.description: Only return conversions associated with this product ID.

action.description: The action represented by the conversion.

consentGrantedAt.description: When marketing consent was granted, in ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

metadata.description: Integration-defined event metadata. Additional fields are accepted but not displayed in the Laylo UI.

name.description: A non-empty, human-readable name for what the fan converted on, such as an event name (Summer Tour 2026 - Los Angeles) or a merch item name (Tour Hoodie).

source.description: Optional name of the integration source. Defaults to the `X-Laylo-Source` header, then to the API key's label.

timestamp.description: When the event occurred, in ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

user.description: The event subject. Supply a valid email or E.164 phone number. Additional fields are accepted but not displayed in the Laylo UI or echoed in the response.

dropIds.description: Only include fans who purchased any of these drop IDs.

excludedDropIds.description: Exclude fans who purchased any of these drop IDs.

conversionIds.description: Only include fans associated with any of these conversion IDs.

excludedConversionIds.description: Exclude fans associated with any of these conversion IDs.

locations.description: Location filters as a JSON-encoded array of location objects.

excludedLocations.description: Excluded locations as a JSON-encoded array of location objects. A fan is left out when every location Laylo has for them is excluded, matching who a segment message reaches; a fan with no known location is always left out.

signedUpAfter.description: Only include fans who signed up at or after this time, in ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

signedUpBefore.description: Only include fans who signed up before this time (exclusive), in ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

dryRun.description: Defaults to false. When true, nothing is created or sent: the request is validated like a real one, and the response shows the cost estimate, with a null id. A dry run doesn't use the Idempotency-Key.

email.description: Required when segment.signUpType is email, and not allowed for sms. The email body is laid out from message the way the Laylo message composer's magic template does it: the text becomes headings and paragraphs and its links become buttons.

message.description: The text to send, up to 1600 characters. The first link gets https:// added when it has no scheme. For an email segment this is the content the email is built from.

segment.description: The same filters GET /v1/fans/segments counts with, as a JSON object. signedUpAfter and signedUpBefore can't both be sent, and at most 30 locations and excluded locations are allowed combined.

sendAt.description: When to send, as the local date and time in timezone with no offset, like 2026-11-20T19:00. Must be at least 5 minutes and at most 2 years from now, and is rounded up to the next five-minute mark.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone sendAt is written in. Daylight saving is applied for the date: a time skipped when clocks spring forward is rejected, and a time repeated when they fall back uses the first occurrence.

dryRun.description: Defaults to false. When true, nothing is created or sent: the request is validated like a real one, and the response shows the cost estimate, with a null id. A dry run doesn't use the Idempotency-Key.

fanId.description: The fan's Laylo ID, as returned in a conversation's fanId. No phone number is needed or returned.

cursor.description: An opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

limit.description: Items per page; defaults to 50 and caps at 200.

awaitingReply.description: Only return fans who texted after the customer's last reply.

unreadOnly.description: Only return fans whose newest text the customer hasn't opened in the Laylo dashboard.

since.description: Only return fans whose newest text was sent at or after this ISO 8601 date-time. The inbox only looks back 90 days, so an earlier date, or none, means 90 days ago.
